children: The unanimous vote by Fed policy makers to raise rates Wednesday likely spared central-bank Chairman Kevin Warsh some additional heartburn with President Trump.

Some analysts had speculated before the decision that Trump's other appointees to the Fed's board of governors-either Michelle Bowman or Christopher Waller-might vote against raising rates. Such a dissent could have helped validate Trump's view that the increase wasn't really necessary, while undermining a White House narrative that Warsh was forced to raise rates by other policy makers.
